      Platform
      Everything you need to work with data
      
        OpenDataBD brings together government statistics, research datasets, and
        citizen surveys into one open-access platform.

        Open Data Repository
        
          Browse and download structured datasets across health, education, climate,
          and economy — all under open licenses.
        
      

      
        [ ~ ]
        Live Surveys
        
          Participate in or launch national surveys. Results are published as open
          datasets after each survey closes.
        
      

      
        [ ↑ ]
        Data Submission
        
          Researchers, NGOs, and government bodies can submit datasets through a
          community review and metadata process.
        
      

      
        [ {} ]
        Developer API
        
          Programmatic access to all datasets via a RESTful JSON API — for
          applications, dashboards, and research pipelines.
        
      

      
        [ ⊞ ]
        Government Collaboration
        
          A dedicated portal for ministries and agencies to publish official
          statistics and administrative records.
        
      

      
        [ ◎ ]
        Research Projects
        
          Register ongoing projects, link datasets, and invite collaborators.
          Build a transparent record of data-driven work.

title: Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey 2026
text:
Active
        Closes Dec 31, 2026
      
      
        Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey 2026
      
      
        This national survey measures public trust in government institutions,
        public services, and governance processes across Bangladesh. Your
        anonymous responses help researchers and policymakers understand how
        citizens experience governance.
      
      
        
          OrganisationOpenDataBD Research Team
        
        
          Duration~8 minutes
        
        
          AnonymityFully anonymous
        
        
          ResultsPublished as open data
        
      
    

    

    
    
      
        
      
      Take the Survey
    

    
      Opens a secure, anonymous survey form. No login required.
    

    

    
    
      
        About this survey
      
      
        The Bangladesh Governance Trust Survey 2026 is part of OpenDataBD's
        annual citizen feedback initiative. It covers five thematic areas:
        institutional trust, local government service delivery, anti-corruption
        perceptions, digital public services, and justice & rule of law.
        Results will be published as an open dataset under a CC BY 4.0 licence
        once the survey closes.
      
    

    
    
      
        ← Back to Active Surveys
